newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE sugar off lows PM, volume stays unimpressive.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE sugar off lows PM, volume stays unimpressive.

text.p: LIFFE sugar was still down, if off lows in afternoon trade.
Volume remained unimpressive, and the market was in a tight range, staying close to New York, traders said.
By 1545 GMT August, the most active month, was 60 cents lower at $323.00, off a low of $321.50. of a total 995 lots, 524 were on August.
"It's just gyrating around New York," one trader said. " 1,000 lots is nothing to shout about. It's just languishing around," he said.
There was some premium and spread trading in the market, but it remained largely directionless, he said.
